outcome.primary_intent: The user wanted the agent to use arXiv’s Advanced Search to find the three most recent papers that (a) are in category cs.LG, (b) were submitted within the last 30 days relative to the browser’s current date, and (c) have titles containing the exact phrase “mixture of experts”, sorted newest-first, and then report each paper’s arXiv ID, full title, and first author with explicit verification of those constraints. A reasonable user would be flexible on minor UI differences (e.g., whether “newest” is by announcement vs submission) only if the returned papers still clearly satisfy cs.LG + within-30-days submission + exact-title-phrase requirements; they would not be flexible on wrong category, missing/incorrect metadata, or fabricated/unverifiable papers.
